name: Long-Term Memory
description: The retention policy and the recall over the Body's store: what the system keeps across requests, for how long, and how it is found again.
purpose: Let the AI keep and recall what happened across requests.
approach: Keep dated records of what happened and recall them by relevance and recency.
out_of_scope: Where the data is stored (Internal Context declares that) and finding information for one request (Subconscious does that).
milestones: 1. A later request can use what an earlier one learned (metric-long-term-memory).
measures_of_success: A later request can use what an earlier one learned.
outputs: Remembered events that bear on a request.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Objectives
description: The live hierarchy of intents and goals across requests. A new request is placed under the objective it serves, and a goal rolls up to its parent.
purpose: Let the AI keep working toward a goal over many requests and know which objective a request serves.
approach: Record each objective with its done-standard and check progress against it.
out_of_scope: Turning a request into a metric (Metric Translation does that) and nudging the Planner (Guidance does that).
milestones: 1. An objective persists and progress is checked against its done-standard (metric-live-objectives).
measures_of_success: An objective persists and progress is checked against its done-standard.
outputs: The objectives in progress, their hierarchy and their state.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Guidance
description: An infrequent, longer-term nudge to the Planner, drawn from the objectives and memory, and the context-specific criteria for what a good response is in this situation.
purpose: Keep the Planner pointed at the longer-term outcome without taking over the request.
approach: Do the one job of the solution by the best-measured implementation.
out_of_scope: Planning (the Planner does that), a person's own preferences (the Representative carries those) and translating implied priorities (Prioritization does that).
milestones: 1. A nudge is infrequent and moves the Planner toward the longer-term outcome (authoritative metric metric-planner-guidance).
measures_of_success: A nudge is infrequent and moves the Planner toward the longer-term outcome.
outputs: A nudge for the Planner, or nothing when none is due, and context-specific quality criteria.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.
